responsibility: This implementation module provides the gm2 fixed-buffer string utilities for nul-terminated ARRAY OF CHAR data. It implements concatenation, lexical comparison, equality testing, length calculation, bounded copying with truncation, substring search, and leading space/tab stripping using explicit character-array loops, serving as the low-level raw-string toolkit beneath higher-level modules like Scan, StrCase, and Environment.
same_name_distinction: Implementation half of the StrLib pair: it provides the concrete nul-terminated ARRAY OF CHAR algorithms for the operations declared in StrLib.def, using explicit loops for copy, length, comparison, concatenation, substring search, and white-prefix stripping.
